In the safety population, adverse events were reported in 77.3% of 295 patients in the tocilizumab group and in 81.1% of 143 patients in the placebo group through day 28

notes: The served counts match the held documents. These are patients with at least one serious adverse event, not numbers of events. Table 3 separately reports 160 and 101 serious adverse events. The outcome uses the safety population classified by the first treatment received, rather than the modified intention-to-treat population stated in row.json. One patient assigned placebo received tocilizumab, yielding safety denominators of 295 and 143 rather than the efficacy-analysis denominators of 294 and 144.
